name: What is the difference between a rough estimate and a detailed cost estimate?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a rough estimate and a detailed cost estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: A rough estimate, often called a conceptual estimate, provides a preliminary cost range based on general project size and scope, using broad averages. It's useful for initial budgeting and feasibility studies. A detailed cost estimate, conversely, is much more precise. It involves a thorough breakdown of all components, including specific material quantities, labor hours, subcontractor bids, equipment costs, and a contingency fund, based on complete architectural plans and specifications. This provides a near-final project cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: A rough estimate is a preliminary cost range for early budgeting. A detailed estimate is a precise breakdown of all costs, based on complete plans, used for final budgeting and contracts.
